offering_description.value: Global investment manager specializing in real assets and alternatives, including real estate securities, listed infrastructure, natural resource equities, commodities, preferred securities and multi-strategy solutions. Serves institutional and individual investors through funds and separate accounts, earning fees on assets managed.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; closed-end funds; separate accounts; private real estate funds

primary_services.value: investment management; investment advisory and subadvisory; portfolio management for institutions

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors such as pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, wealth managers and advisors; B2C: individual investors via mutual funds, ETFs and closed-end funds

end_markets.value: asset management; real estate investing; infrastructure investing; wealth management; institutional investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: investment advisory fees based on assets under management, plus distribution and administration fees; other: performance-based incentive fees on certain accounts

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: manages client capital in securities and real assets, sold to institutions, advisors and retail investors

geography_served.value: global: Clients in the US, Europe, Asia and other regions, with offices in New York, London, Dublin, Hong Kong, Tokyo and Seoul

specialization.value: related lines: real assets and alternatives strategies: real estate, infrastructure, commodities, preferreds, and multi-strategy

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional sales team to pensions, sovereign funds and consultants; partners / resellers: wirehouses, broker-dealers, RIAs, and subadvisory relationships with other firms
